retrievalProfile.description: A multi-paneled photo grid separated by thick red gutters, featuring a mix of color and monochrome urban imagery topped with raw, scratched hand-lettering.
triggerTerms: irregular photo grid with red borders
scratched white hand-lettering on red header
bricolage layout with mixed color and black and white photos
excludeWhen: a clean minimalist single-image layout is required
formal serif or sans-serif typography is preferred

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex mosaic of rectangular photographs of varying sizes, organized into a non-uniform grid. The entire composition is unified by a thick, deep red border that acts as a gutter between every image. The top section features a horizontal red band containing expressive, white, scratched-style hand-lettering. The imagery consists of a blend of warm-toned color photography and high-contrast black and white shots depicting urban life, people, and community.
coreVisualRelationships: Red grid lines acting as both frame and separator for disparate narratives
Contrast between warm, sun-drenched color photos and stark monochrome images
Raw, energetic hand-lettering juxtaposed against structured rectangular framing
Central large vertical panel anchoring smaller peripheral vignettes
coreInvariants: Mix of color and B&W photography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, vertically-oriented color photograph of a group of men is positioned slightly off-center to the top, serving as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The thick red horizontal header containing the title text anchors the top of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top-left text, follows the vertical red gutters down through the central large image, and then zig-zags through the smaller peripheral panels.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Negative space is replaced by the thick red grid lines, creating a dense, packed visual field.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White (lettering and highlights in B&W photos)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Ochre and Sky Blue (within color photographs)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast black and white images balance the saturated red grid and warm-toned color photography.

letterConstructionRules: Scratched or etched appearance with jagged edges
Variable stroke width suggesting a dry brush or sharp tool
Inconsistent baseline and x-height for a raw, urgent feel
Connected and disconnected characters mixed freely
characterSpecificRedesigns: Crossbars on 'A' and 'H' are often extended or slanted
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive hand-drawn style used for all text elements to maintain raw energy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, energetic feel of the original lettering.
Matches the etched, aggressive texture of the strokes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage of 10-12 rectangular photos of varying sizes (some color, some B&W) depicting urban life, separated by thick brick-red gutters. Include a solid red horizontal band at the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom white hand-lettering to the top red band using a scratched, dry-brush style with jagged edges and an urgent, gestural feel.

verificationChecks: Are the red gutters thick and consistent in color?
Is there a mix of color and black-and-white photography?
Does the text look scratched rather than printed?
Is the layout an irregular grid rather than a standard one?

adjustableVariables: Ratio of color to B&W photos
Intensity of the scratched texture in the font
Shade of red for the grid

mustAchieve: Cohesive grid structure despite irregular sizes

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red borders are the primary unifying element.
Verify the text is legible despite the scratched texture.
Check that the collage feels like a single narrative piece.
Confirm the top red header is distinct from the image grid.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a multi-paneled irregular photo grid with thick [Color] gutters and a matching top header containing [Texture] [Style] hand-lettering.
